description: High-performance, cross-platform C# PDF library fully optimized for Native AOT compilation, cloud microservices, and AWS Lambda. Features lightning-fast cold starts and ultra-low memory overhead. Seamlessly create, edit, merge, extract text/images, and handle PDF/A, ZUGFeRD, or Factur-X invoicing. Includes native WinForms/WPF viewers for Windows and native runtimes for Linux (including Alpine musl-libc) and macOS (Intel/Apple Silicon). Broad compatibility from modern .NET 8/9/10 down to legacy .NET Framework 2.0.
releaseNotes: • Technical maintenance and stability improvements. • Full version history and detailed change logs are available at: https://forum.patagames.com/topics/3-Version-History
summary: Advanced .NET library with WinForms and WPF viewers to create, view, edit, and extract data from PDF files without external dependencies.
title: Pdfium.Net SDK
